name: AI Coach
description: Endurance and recovery coach: documented physiological models (HRV baseline, recovery, sleep, training load, early warning) computed on Garmin Connect data via garmin-cli's gc CLI.

gcBinary.description: Path to the garmin-cli `gc` binary (>= 0.4.0). Defaults to "gc" (resolved from PATH).

garminBackend.description: How Garmin data is fetched: "native" runs @sctg/garmin-ts-client in the Gateway process, "gc" uses the garmin-cli binary, "auto" (default) uses native when the package and a token file are present and gc otherwise. Workout creation always uses gc.

garminTokenFile.description: Token file of the native backend. Defaults to $GARMINTOKENS or ~/.config/garmin-cli/tokens/garmin_tokens.json (the file `gc login` writes).

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the athlete, used for day boundaries (e.g. Europe/Paris). Defaults to the Gateway timezone.

dataDir.description: Directory of the local store (nightly aggregates, activities, journal). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/coach.

historyDays.description: Days of recovery history kept in sync. Default 90.

loadHistoryDays.description: Days of activities used by the training-load model. Default 180.

retentionDays.description: Stored data older than this is deleted. Default 730.

cacheMinutes.description: Minimum delay between two Garmin fetches of recent days. Default 15.

birthYear.description: Used only to estimate maximum heart rate when none is measured.

hrMax.description: Measured maximum heart rate (bpm). Strongly recommended.

hrRest.description: Resting heart rate (bpm). Defaults to the 60-day median measured by the watch.

lthr.description: Lactate-threshold heart rate (bpm). Defaults to Garmin's estimate.

sleepNeedHours.description: Personal sleep need used when Garmin does not report one. Default 8.

hrZoneFloorsPctMax.description: Lower bound of heart-rate zones 1-5 in percent of maximum heart rate. Default [50,60,70,80,90].

language.description: Language of the labels drawn in charts (coach_briefing_charts). Default en.

allowWorkoutPush.description: Allow coach_workout_push to create workouts in Garmin Connect (after explicit confirmation). Default false.
